issue.title: Make command-mode FIFO and parallel-read test robust under suite load
issue.description: Investigate the intermittent failure in scripts/test-command-mode-runner.cjs::writers serialize FIFO while reads run in parallel. The test asserts a minimum delay between serialized writer spawns and a strict 590 ms wall-clock bound for overlapping reads; it failed in the full parallel npm test run and passed in the isolated rerun. Identify the timing/load interaction and make the test reliable without weakening its FIFO writer or parallel reader guarantees.

task_type_fields.evidence: Observed 1 failure in the full npm test run under parallel suite load. Focused rerun `node --test --test-name-pattern="writers serialize FIFO while reads run in parallel" scripts/test-command-mode-runner.cjs` passed 1/1 (2.38 s) on the unchanged test file. No isolated failure observed; current sample is one full-suite failure and one focused pass.

issue.creation_reason: A full npm test run failed this unchanged test, while a focused rerun passed, so its timing assertion needs investigation before it can reliably gate the plugin suite.

payload.description: Recent test-only load-tolerance work on completion tests may offer a useful strategy, though the plugin runner and assertion are distinct.
